meta.re_freeze_reason: Restore the regime chassis into the New Brain (docs/plans/2026-06-23-restore-regime-chassis-into-new-brain.md). The cutover had dropped config/regime_compatibility.json — the regime picker's multiplier series the orthogonal members were specced to add value ON TOP OF (PROPOSAL_ORTHOGONALITY §0) — leaving the live book regime-blind (regime_admissibility {} AND regime_exposure_multiplier {}); it loaded ~51% into one correlated high-beta complex and took −3.37% vs SPY −1.27% on 2026-06-23. This re-freeze (a) restores regime into Stage-1 ranking via ForecastBundle.regime_score_mult (engine_sha moved: contracts.py + selection.py), and (b) restores the Stage-2 regime exposure cut via theta_size.regime_exposure_multiplier (theta_size content_hash moved). theta_sel is unchanged. Per the no-mid-stream bound this terminates the prior LIVE_PREREG reads and opens a fresh forward pre-registration with start date 2026-06-24.
meta.purpose: Forward-only freeze of the LIVE brain. These hashes are asserted at cold start (PKT-TB-012). The LIVE brain is the native two-stage engine, NOT tilt_adapter. No artifact below may move without terminating the LIVE_PREREG reads and opening a fresh pre-registration (LIVE_PREREG.md §3).
meta.non_assertion: Freezing these artifacts asserts only that the forward measurement runs against a fixed instrument. It does NOT assert the brain has a dollar edge. The exposure-stripped selection residual is measured at zero (-0.29 bp/day, t≈-0.22).

theta_sel.no_mid_stream_bound: Any change to any theta_sel value (which changes content_hash) terminates the LIVE_PREREG reads and requires a fresh pre-registration with a fresh start date (LIVE_PREREG.md §3). 'Frozen by hand' is leakage-safe ONLY under this bound (Analyst C4 — closes defect-B-via-the-human).

theta_size.regime_exposure_provenance: Restored 2026-06-23. The book-level gross multiplier G = gross_target x regime_exposure_multiplier[regime] cuts exposure in risk-off/panic regimes — the de-risking the original chassis did via the regime_compatibility equity factor (risk_on 1.10 / choppy 0.95 / risk_off 0.85 / panic 0.50). Mapped to gross scalars: panic halves gross (holds ~50% cash), risk_off 0.75, choppy 0.90, risk_on/calm 1.0 (never levers above gross_target). Hand-frozen; prior to falsify.
theta_size.note: theta_size is frozen alongside theta_sel. parity_gain is the closed-loop ex-post parity controller gain (F8 fix). theta_size NEVER reaches Stage-1 Select (enforced by assert_no_dollar_surface); freezing it pins the realized book, not the held set.
